tools.name: rrsi
tools.description: Record, import and replay GJC exploration traces through the bundled Dream-RSI core (capture | import | dream | status). capture stores a bounded episode (goal plus attempts with features/outcome); import projects the jev-advisor journal and/or a self-improve ledger into attempts (read-only); dream ranks deterministic policies over the store off-policy; status reports store counts and storage state. Keyless and offline: no network, no credentials, no model calls, and the private store lives under ~/.gjc-plugin/rrsi/ (0700/0600, never committed).
